_about: Build 2026-11-15b (test 53's and test 54's wishes), packaged on 2026-11-10a's package as the asset base (2026-11-14a and 2026-11-15a changed no asset) with an overlay of the four meshes this build changes, built by tools/rider/bar_cables.py into /opt/cmb/assets15b/Data (OVERLAY=/opt/cmb/assets15b/Data: a Data-like folder, Meshes/CMB/... at its top). Keys starting with _ are comments. The textures, materials, sounds, clips, CMB_BikeParked.nif and CMB_BikeParts.ini are 2026-11-10a's. The commit's own files that change (checked against the commit, not listed below): Data/CommonwealthMotorbike.esp, Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.dll, Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.ini, Data/MCM/Config/CommonwealthMotorbike/config.json and the sources CMB_ControllerScript.psc and CMB_GearRestoreF4SE.psc (git diff --stat 1bc3f8a <the build's commit> -- Data).
_previous: The 2026-11-15a package: the verifier's --previous. Its Data holds the same assets as 2026-11-10a's, either can be the asset base (ASSETS=<it>/Data), with this build's OVERLAY over it.

esp._records: espcmp.py 1bc3f8a's ESP against this one: 'TES4: HEDR records 1053 -> 1062, next ID 0xBFF -> 0xC08', 'added 9 (000BFF-000C07): 8 GLOB, 1 FLST', 'removed 0', 'changed 1' (00080D QUST CMB_ControllerQuest: VMAD). No new group: the FLST joins the existing FLST group.
esp._edids: This build's nine new forms first (first person's four at 000BFF-000C02, the weapons' five at 000C03-000C07, CMB_HandgunKeywords the FLST), then 2026-11-15a's list: the eight globals of 2026-11-14a (000BF7-000BFE), the look item, the controller quest and 2026-11-10a's two globals.

_counts: As 2026-11-15a's: no file added or removed. The four meshes change in place; make_rider_plugin.py's new CMB_RiderPose_report.txt is written on the player's PC beside CMB_RiderPose.esp and is never in a package (tools/rider is not packaged, and the packager takes only the commit's tracked Data files, the compiled scripts and the asset roots).
_vs_previous: The assets and the compiled scripts compared with the previous package: the four nifs of the overlay (the three worn ones and the first-person one, the right-hand cables cut into <stem>_front_cables; sha256 as bar_cables.py wrote them, the same in two runs), and the two scripts whose sources changed (git diff --stat 1bc3f8a <the build's commit> -- Data/Scripts: CMB_ControllerScript.psc, CMB_GearRestoreF4SE.psc), which compile to new code. null accepts any content; verify_zips.py --list-changes prints each one's sha256 to paste in after the first package (step 3 of tools/package/README.md).
